components.text: Sign in to Discord and open the application that owns your bot, or create one. This connection is for a bot account; do not paste a normal user's login token.

In the application's Bot settings, create or reset the bot token and copy it into the protected field. Install the bot in the intended server with the necessary permissions before calling guild APIs. Resetting a token invalidates the previous one.

Choose a Ragentic workspace and connection name. Test calls GET /users/@me with the Bot authorization scheme and checks the bot user ID. It does not test server membership, gateway intents, or permissions. Save encrypts the token and offers a one-time connector export.
This is an independent integration for Discord services; it is not affiliated with or endorsed by Discord.
